title.en: Share files with a public link
title.zh: 文件支持公开链接分享

description.en: Create a link from a file's Share menu; anyone with it can view and download the file without signing in. The link can be turned off at any time.
description.zh: 在文件的「分享」菜单中可创建公开链接，对方无需登录即可查看和下载；链接可随时关闭。

title.en: Download and share from the artifact panel
title.zh: 产物面板支持下载与分享

description.en: Files opened beside a conversation can now be downloaded, linked and shared directly from the panel.
description.zh: 在会话旁打开的文件可直接在面板中下载、复制链接和分享。

description.en: Switching between conversations, issues and files responds immediately, and large file libraries no longer freeze the window.
description.zh: 在会话、Issue 和文件之间切换会立即响应，文件较多的工作区也不会再导致窗口卡顿。
